ownership.quote: Vultr was founded in 2014 by David Aninowsky.

stage.quote: Vultr raises $333 million in growth financing, its first external funding since its founding in 2014, at a valuation of $3.5 billion, signaling a strategic push towards AI cloud infrastructure.
stage.note: Vultr was bootstrapped/self-funded for a decade; its only outside round to date (Dec 2024) is a $333M 'growth financing' round rather than a numbered series round. Mapped to series-d+ given its size ($333M) and post-money valuation ($3.5B), which are typical of late-stage growth rounds, not an early series label.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sole external financing round to date, reported by multiple sources including Wikipedia and HyperFRAME Research, sourced to a Vultr/BusinessWire press release.
total_funding_usd.quote: In 2024, Vultr raised $333 million led by AMD and LuminArx Capital Management.

last_round.quote: Vultr secures $333 million in growth financing, led by AMD Ventures and LuminArx Capital Management.

revenue.basis: Growjo third-party estimate; no primary source confirms a revenue figure, and this estimate looks low relative to Vultr's stated $3.5B valuation and reported hundreds of thousands of customers, so treat with caution.
revenue.quote: Vultr's estimated annual revenue is currently $37.2M per year.

note: Vultr (legal entity The Constant Company, LLC) was founded in 2014 by David Aninowsky and was bootstrapped/profitable for roughly a decade before taking its first-ever outside capital: a $333M growth financing co-led by AMD Ventures and LuminArx Capital Management, closed December 2024, valuing the company at $3.5B. In 2025 it also secured $329M in separate credit financing (debt, not equity) from banks including Bank of America, Citi, and Goldman Sachs, and is building a >$1B, 50MW AMD GPU data center cluster in Ohio. No accelerator/incubator affiliation found. Revenue/employee figures here are unverified third-party (Growjo) estimates only.
